The Presence Pipeline — Vika.quote: In a side-view exercise the far-side joints are legitimately occluded and carry low presence, which drags the average down even with a perfectly-framed user — nudging the low-presence poke to fire more than it needs to. Weighting by visibility, or averaging only the camera-side joints (the same side-aware idea the scale-factor work uses), would make the signal cleaner. Behaviour-preserving refactor kept it as-is on purpose; worth a follow-up.
